title: Power Supply To Several Jammu Areas To Remain Affected - Kashmir Life
full_text:
SRINAGAR: Power supply to several areas of Jammu and Samba districts will remain affected on September 13, 14 and 16 due to scheduled maintenance works, the Jammu Power Distribution Corporation Limited (JPDCL) said.
According to JPDCL, power supply to Talabtillo, Trilokpur, Bohri, Udheywala, Machelian, Marh, Gajansoo, Gho Manhasan and adjoining areas will remain affected on September 13 from 6 am to 11 am.
Supply to Jakh, Vijaypur, UFLEX, Sarore, Narbada Industry, Bari Brahmana town, the Industrial Area and adjoining areas will also remain affected on September 13, from 6 am to 12 noon.
In another scheduled outage, power supply to Khidkein Talab, Shaheedi Chowk, DC Office Road, Auto Stand Dalpatian Mohalla and areas near J&K Bank will remain affected on September 14 and 15 from 8 am to 1 pm, according to the Executive Engineer, Electrical Division-I, JPDCL, Parade, Jammu.
Meanwhile, the Superintending Engineer (Distribution), JPDCL O&M Circle, Kathua, said power supply to Samba-I, Samba-V and PHE Industrial areas will remain affected on September 14 and 16 from 7 am to 1 pm.
Consumers in the affected areas have been advised to take note of the scheduled power interruptions.
